name: Little Girl On Earth Asking Why She Asking Why
source:
"Life sometimes feels like it's going in circles. The little girl on Earth tells herself this, forever."

Little Girl On Earth Asking Why She Asking Why is a very short pixel art Visual Novel, about a girl who has a lot of questions to ask you. Answer her questions and make her feel more alive.
[i][b](don't be too rude with her please)[/b][/i]

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4426850/]Steam[/url]]
